terms.title: Purpose
terms.body: This document presents the provisional structure of AWA’s terms of use.

terms.title: Use of the application
terms.body: AWA offers personal tracking and well-being tools. The final content describing users’ rights and responsibilities will be added once legal validation is complete.

terms.title: Service availability
terms.body: The final terms governing the service’s availability, maintenance, and evolution are still to be confirmed.

terms.title: Contact
terms.body: Official contact details will be added once validated by the AWA team.

privacy.title: Data concerned
privacy.body: This section will precisely describe the data processed by AWA and its purpose, once legal validation is complete.

privacy.title: Storage and security
privacy.body: The final documentation will specify the storage measures, protections, and retention periods.

privacy.title: Your rights
privacy.body: The procedures for accessing, correcting, or deleting your data will be detailed in the validated version.

privacy.title: Privacy contact
privacy.body: The official contact address for the privacy officer will be added before publication.
